The long way to that first Machu Picchu view.

A 3 a.m. pickup , around twelve kilometres of stone paths and 575 photographs later, I finally have the full story to share with you.

By Dainyel · Sent 14 November 2026

POSTCARDS FROM DAINYEL Take the scenic route.

Hi there,

A 3 a.m. pickup , around twelve kilometres of stone paths and 575 photographs later, I finally have the full story to share with you.

My Cusco and 2-day Inca Trail blog is now online . Come along for the climb to Wiñay Wayna, the first view of Machu Picchu from the Sun Gate and a guide who made sure we went home with plenty of stories—and photographs.

There are also the honest bits: how differently the three of us reacted to the altitude, the sunrise that stayed behind the clouds and a rather long wait for the return train.

I have added photographs, useful links and a few facts along the way. If you have a quiet moment, this is a good one to settle in with.

Would you hike in, or choose the train? Hit reply and tell me. I would love to know which part of the trip you would be most excited about.
